This Request for Proposals (the “RFP”) is an invitation by the Nova Scotia Independent Energy 
System Operator (“IESO Nova Scotia”) to prospective proponents to submit proposals for 
**Forecast Fuel and Electricity Market Pricing,** as further described in Section A of the RFP 
Particulars (Appendix D) (the “Deliverables”).

IESO Nova Scotia is seeking proposals from qualified consultants to provide forecast fuel and 
electricity market pricing to support the development of its Integrated Resource Plan (IRP). The 
Deliverables comprise long-term (2027 to 2055) forecasts for a range of fuel commodities, 
including natural gas (Henry Hub, with AGT and AECO basis), LNG (Dutch TTF), heavy fuel oil 
or Brent crude oil, No. 2 fuel oil, and low and mid sulfur Columbian coal, together with electricity 
energy, capacity, and Renewable Energy Credit (REC) market pricing for ISO New England, in 
each case including high and low forecasts.

The Deliverables are described in detail in Section A of the RFP Particulars (Appendix D). 
Proponents need not be able to provide all of the requested forecasts in order to submit a 
proposal. This RFP is organized into three parts and a set of appendices: Part 1 sets out the 
invitation and submission instructions; Part 2 describes the evaluation, negotiation, and award 
process; Part 3 contains the terms and conditions governing the RFP process; and the 
appendices contain the Form of Agreement (Appendix A), Submission Form (Appendix B), Pricing 
(Appendix C), and RFP Particulars (Appendix D)."],"source_version":"475894bd9321983952b18e207461a6ec35e7a89358af60c7eeabaf8c11f89bf8","tenant_id":"public","verified_available_at":"2026-10-02T13:57:48.746449+00:00"}],"scenario_id":"PRF-008","schema_version":"procurement-arena-scenario-v1","seed":1007,"tenant_id":"public","timeline":["2026-10-02T13:57:47.746449+00:00","2026-10-02T13:57:48.746449+00:00"],"truth":{"outcome":"GENERATION_NOT_IN_SCOPE","procurement_episode_id":"ieso-forecast-pricing-2026","solicitation_at":null},"version":"1"}
